work_history.title: HR Operation Manager
work_history.description:
Recruitment - process on-boarding and off-boarding of employees. Application & issue of MOM work pass / S Pass / EP.
Performance management - used appraisal forms / web page to gather staff results and sat in management meetings to review grades / results.
Compensation and benefits - review and align salary ranges, staff allowances and annual leave for different staff grades.
Training & development - review and plan staff training, track expiry dates, advise on suitable courses.
HRIS - create and delete staff accounts in the company HR system.
Payroll processing - review and process monthly payroll for 3 employment types; year-end tax for IRAS submission.
Handle HR and admin matters (insurance / medical), created an employee feedback process.

work_history.title: HR Manager
work_history.description: HR duties - recruitment, performance management, compensation and benefits, training & development, HRIS and payroll. Created HR policies and processes for Singapore / China / Vietnam offices.

work_history.title: HR Manager (Regional)
work_history.description:
HR duties - recruitment, performance management, compensation and benefits, training & development, HRIS and payroll; created policies and processes for employees.
Assisted in weekly and monthly management meetings; assisted HODs in yearly KPI planning and talent route maps.
HR and admin matters (insurance / HR system contract renewal / EP / S Pass / WP). Member of Internal Audit (ISO), Safety (ISO/HSE) and Risk committees. Handled HR for Singapore and representative offices in Thailand / Vietnam / Indonesia / Malaysia.
HR projects: salary structure benchmarking and adjustments; renewal of personnel insurances (local and expat); HR department audit; change of HRIS; employee development, company events, feedback and incentive programme.

work_history.title: HR Business Partner
work_history.description:
Business partnering with business units on global recruitment and selection.
Insurance, leave and medical benefits administration; business visa, exit permit and vendor coordination.
Advised managers and HODs on HR policy issues.
Achievements: recruited for difficult positions, handled staff disputes (contracts and benefits) and administered disciplinary procedures; involved in HR policy and procedure implementation (Qatar); assisted in annual appraisal for site staff.

work_history.title: Regional HR Generalist
work_history.description:
Partnered with business unit heads to identify and develop strategic HR programs.
Recruitment for various departments and business units.
Insurance, leave and medical benefits administration; expatriate management (work pass / tax / housing); training & development administration; payroll administration; annual appraisal and awards.
Achievements: completed urgent recruitment within required timelines for business units; handled the yearly change in company insurance policy.

work_history.title: HR Officer cum Office Manager
work_history.description:
Manpower planning, training & development, year-end appraisal.
Supervised general staff (admin / reception / dispatch / lounge / cleaning).
Set up HR department (employee handbook, HR policies, orientation material).
Staff insurance, leave and medical benefits administration; employment pass applications; oversaw payroll; coordinated company events; office admin and building maintenance.
Achievements: set up HR policy and employee handbook; developed training plans and career advancement plans; conducted salary adjustments for all staff.

work_history.title: Senior Executive (HR Services)
work_history.description:
Serviced outsourcing clients (banking and technology companies) on monthly / weekly headcount reports and personnel data input to HRIS / PeopleSoft.
Prepared offer letters and reference checks for a banking client; coordinated medical screening for new hires and interns.
Monthly expatriate expenses management; coordinated monthly compensation & benefits for a client; assisted with employment pass matters.

Fixed Assets Approving Officer and GeBIZ Administrator.
